_about: TODO-19 turn 5 pitch confirmation on fresh seeds (RO_CONFIRMATION32). Restricted to the decision: the two rule picks (p1.0-g0 DPC r0.01, p3.2-g0.5 DPC r0.03) and the nearest alternatives (both ratios at 1.0, 2.2 and 3.2 mm pitch, 0.2 and 0.5 mm walls at 3.2 mm); four outputs, sum trigger 50 keV, specular 0.98 reflector, DirectCrystal as the built-in reference; the same lines and rates. FloodHistoriesPerCrystal is 3000 (ten times the selection budget) because the seed-to-seed spread of 662 keV mis-identification equals binomial counting noise; see confirmation-pin-v1.json for the derivation and the rule.
